summary: Canadian Natural Resources filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) furnishing a press release dated November 5, 2026 announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of C$0.625 per common share, payable January 5, 2027 to holders of record December 15, 2026. The board declared the dividend, noting 2026 marks the 26th consecutive annual increase with a 20% CAGR. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, or strategic review is involved; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special situation.
